title: How much of a public utility district's 1,000 MW baseload need its offers can fill under the state's 925-pound emissions performance standard, and from which plants: each offered gas plant's carbon dioxide per net megawatt-hour under its commitment, conformed from EPA's hourly emissions and the plants' revenue meters
subdomain: emissions-inventory (a power-sector carbon dioxide inventory for ten offered gas plants: EPA hourly emissions per monitored stack, revenue-meter net generation, the EIA generator and generation surveys and the EPA-EIA crosswalk conformed into each plant's emission rate)
prompt_shape: 01: a ranked list under a cap, the 1,000 MW need filled in order of capacity price from the offers whose plants meet the 925-pound standard; every offered plant's emission rate, its 2025 forced outage hours and outages and its 2025 hours of substitute data
